findings.title: 9 pre-existing sub-agents missing constitution-reference
findings.description: All sub-agents in recipe/sub/ and recipe/sub/demo-team/ should have `constitution: sub_mas-master-constitution.yaml`. 9 pre-existing files (mostly marketing-team + e2e-german-fixes + analytics-reporter) are missing this. R31+R32 created 37 more but those were manually fixed in 561f4ed.
findings.fix: Add `constitution: sub_mas-master-constitution.yaml` line right after `name:` line in each file
findings.estimated_effort: 1 patch (9 files updated in one go)

findings.title: Mas-engineer consistently forgets constitution-reference when creating new sub-agents
findings.description: Across R26, R27, R30, R31, R32: mas-engineer created 60+ new sub-agents, NONE had constitution-reference initially. Only fixed by external manual commit (561f4ed). This is a systematic bug in the agent-creation step of the design/apply pipeline.
findings.evidence: git log eba5230 --name-only | grep -E 'sub_mas-.*\.yaml$' | wc-l = 21 (all without constitution until 561f4ed)
findings.fix: Add a post-step in sub_mas-im-applier that auto-injects constitution-reference into any newly created sub-agent YAML if missing
findings.estimated_effort: 1 patch (modify sub_mas-im-applier to add constitution after name)

findings.title: sub_mas-pre-push-validator lacks constitution-coverage check
findings.description: Pre-push-validator has 9 checks but does NOT check that sub-agents have constitution-reference. Without this check, the F-CONST-001 bug went undetected. Should add a check that all files in recipe/sub/**/*.yaml have constitution field set to sub_mas-master-constitution.yaml (with sensible exceptions for master-constitution.yaml itself).
findings.evidence: Read recipe/sub/sub_mas-pre-push-validator.yaml — no check for constitution field
findings.fix: Add a 10th check in pre-push-validator: parse all sub-agents, count those without constitution-reference, FAIL if count > 0

findings.title: sub_mas-pre-push-validator is interactive (R01 confirmation) — blocks non-interactive runs
findings.description: When run with --no-session + RECURSION_OVERRIDE, pre-push-validator cannot be invoked because it asks for R01 user confirmation. This forced manual 9-check fallback. Should detect non-interactive context and skip R01.
findings.evidence: Tried `goose run --recipe recipe/sub/sub_mas-pre-push-validator.yaml --no-session` — hangs at R01 confirmation prompt
findings.fix: Modify validator to detect `--no-session` mode (RECURSION_OVERRIDE or NO_SESSION env) and proceed without confirmation. Alternative: split validator into non-interactive variant.
